name: Salmon Dip
description: A quick and flavorful red salmon spread perfect for crackers or sandwiches.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp garlic powder or 1 fresh garlic clove, minced

recipeInstructions.text: Drain the salmon and remove any bones.
Use a fork to flake the salmon before adding other ingredients.
Combine the softened cream cheese with the salmon and all remaining ingredients.
Mix well and serve with crackers or as a spread.

keywords: salmon dip, salmon spread, red salmon

_similar.name: Shrimp Spread
_similar.description: A savory shrimp and cheddar cheese spread served with crackers.

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together in a medium bowl.
Mash the shrimp with a fork until well blended.
Refrigerate before serving with crackers.

_similar.keywords: shrimp spread, seafood dip, party appetizer

_similar.name: Party Salmon Ball
_similar.description: A classic chilled salmon and cream cheese ball coated in crunchy nuts and parsley.
recipeIngredient: 1 (16 oz) can salmon, drained and flaked

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together except for the nuts and parsley.
Shape the mixture into a ball.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours (but no longer than 4 days).
Roll the ball in a mixture of nuts and parsley to coat evenly before serving.

_similar.keywords: salmon ball, cheese ball, party dip, holiday appetizer

_similar.name: Crab & Cheese Platter
_similar.description: A layered seafood appetizer featuring a creamy cheese base topped with cocktail sauce and crab meat.
recipeIngredient: 2 large packages (8 oz each) cream cheese

recipeInstructions.text: Mix together the cream cheese, lemon juice, Worcestershire sauce, mayonnaise and onion flakes in a blender, or beat with an electric mixer, until smooth and creamy.
Spread cheese mixture evenly over the surface of a large round platter, leaving room around the outside for a row of crackers.
Press the centre of the cheese mixture down lightly to make a slightly raised border, about ½ to 1 in wide, around the outer edge.
Spread seafood cocktail sauce over the cheese layer within this border, leaving an outside rim of the cheese layer showing.
Drain the crab meat and spread it over the sauce layer, again leaving a border of seafood sauce showing.
Serve with crackers or vegetables.

_similar.keywords: crab dip, layered platter, seafood appetizer

_similar.name: Fluffy Fruit Dip
_similar.description: A light and airy fruit dip made with softened cream cheese, marshmallow creme, and vanilla extract.

recipeInstructions.text: In a bowl, combine the softened cream cheese, marshmallow creme, and vanilla extract.
Mix until smooth and well blended.
Serve immediately with your choice of fresh fruit.

_similar.keywords: fluffy fruit dip, marshmallow dip, sweet appetizer

_similar.name: Artichoke Appetizer
_similar.description: A warm, cheesy artichoke appetizer perfect for serving with bread or crackers.

recipeInstructions.text: Drain artichoke hearts.
Combine artichoke hearts with cheese, mayonnaise, garlic salt, and green onion in a casserole dish.
Sprinkle parsley over the top.
Bake at 350°F for 25 to 30 minutes.
Serve with bread or crackers.

_similar.keywords: artichoke appetizer, cheesy dip, party snack
